name: meshsense
description: MeshSense directly connects to your Meshtastic node via Bluetooth or WiFi and continuously provides information to assess the health of your mesh network.

scripts.build:mac: npm -w ui run build && npm -w api run build && npm -w electron run build:mac -- -a universal
scripts.build:win: npm -w ui run build && npm -w api run build && npm -w electron run build:win
scripts.build:linux: npm -w ui run build && npm -w api run build && npm -w electron run build:linux
